items.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full
items.summary: Meta released Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, which it calls its most capable models to date. Muse Wonder is available through the Meta Model API and Muse Code; Muse Wonder Full is available to Muse Code subscribers. Meta says the models were released under its Meta Superintelligence Scaling Framework and that a full report with more safety evaluations will follow.
items.why_not_cyber: Major model launch; no cyber evidence published yet (Meta says a fuller safety report will follow).

items.title: Fired OpenAI researchers say they were let go for prioritising safety
items.summary: Three former OpenAI safety and alignment researchers say they were fired for raising safety concerns. OpenAI says its investigation found they mishandled sensitive information and that the decision was not about safety concerns.
items.why_not_cyber: Staffing dispute at a leading AI company with no cyber security angle.

items.title: Summary of METR's pre-deployment evaluation of Claude Opus 5.5
items.summary: METR's independent pre-deployment evaluation found Claude Opus 5.5 is likely a modest improvement over Fable 5.1 on AI R&D tasks and unlikely to fully automate AI R&D. The summary does not cover cyber capabilities.
items.why_not_cyber: Evaluation of a model release with no cyber security findings.

items.title: First state-level lawsuit against OpenAI and Sam Altman
items.summary: Alleges ChatGPT prioritised profit over safety.
items.why_not_cyber: Legal action about AI safety in general, with no cyber angle.
